findings.msg: has 4 gradients: one field per view (C2)
is 62% color, with a wash that covers 28%: color covers at most a third of a view, not counting photos or the wash, unless the field fills it (Art. 5.2)
is a button with no fill and no outline: a button is a pill or a filled shape
is drawn in the state "all", which is not on the list: add it with node scripts/ui-states.mjs state screen all "<where it came up>", so every screen is asked about it
is not drawn in the states new, empty, one, typical, dense, loading, failed, offline: draw each, or say why it can't happen with data-skip="new: why"
has no wordmark: a main screen carries "secondhand" in its navigation bar, and a sheet does not (C1)
--mint and --marigold-tint are 0.041 apart to an eye with no red cones: two colors that mark different things in one view stay .05 apart in Oklab
is an amount with nothing beside it saying what it is: "You keep $46.95", not "$46.95" (C6)
spills out of [amount]: a thing holds what is in it (ledger L37)
has 2 display headings ("Nothing needs you", "Connect a site"): one per view besides the wordmark (Art. 6)
is only black, white and gray, with no color ground and no photo: it will read as no brand (ledger L2)
